scope_audits.source_metric_caveats: Source 50 km heat-budget box width is a modeling choice; 750 km Gimsøy–Bjørnøya path is a segment convention. Neither transferred to the Norwegian Current. Static 50%-mean-transport core differs from a dated full-current width.
scope_audits.source_sampling_context: 1993–2022 repeated CTD sections plus satellite surface geostrophic reference; not an observation date for the ambiguous Norwegian Current.
scope_audits.summary: NOAA Norwegian Current is a broad northeastward off-Norway naming convention. The modern Norwegian Atlantic Current, with separate slope and front branches, is not automatically this ledger identity or the Norwegian Coastal Current. Name equivalence remains unresolved; whole-current dimensions remain unknown.
